headline: Communist tempo? Union sends message to workers rejoicing over wealth tax
summary: The Egyenlő.hu union said taxing wealth would not give workers more income, urging against celebrating the tax on billionaires. Employer representatives and a growing number of entrepreneurs increasingly object to the wealth tax.
why: Wealth taxes change the cost of capital and investment incentives for high-net-worth investors and businesses.
